newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dah Bang buys Golik Metal for HK$149 mln.
newsitem.headline: Dah Bang buys Golik Metal for HK$149 mln.

text.p: Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it had reached a conditional agreement to buy Golik Metal Industrial Co Ltd for HK$149 million from Golik International Group Ltd.
Golik International is the controlling shareholder of Dah Bang, holding 50.30 percent of the issued share capital.
Dah Bang said in a statement it would pay HK$59 million in cash and the remaining HK$90 million through the issue of 100 million new Dah Bang shares to Golik at HK$0.90 per share.
Trading in Dah Bang shares was suspended on February 26 and is due to resume on Monday. The stock last traded at HK$1.23.
